vulnerabilityAlerts.description: Owner, 2026-11-16 (#6031): each security fix merges itself, major versions too, after the required checks of the ruleset main pass. GitHub auto-merge does the merge, so no check is skipped. The shared preset turns no automerge on.

customManagers.description: The Grafana plugins that Grafana preinstalls, pinned as <id>@<version> in the plugins value (#2022).
The Python minor of the setup-uv python-version inputs.
The Python minor of the apt package and the tool environments of the devcontainer image.
The Python minor of the type checkers, the tools lock and DEFAULT_PYTHON_VERSION.
The Python minor of the uv compile command in the header of each hashed requirements file of the tools lock, and in the bump steps of tools.lock.
The PostgreSQL image of a CloudNativePG Cluster (spec.imageName), which the kubernetes manager does not read. The Image Updater values hold a deeper imageName field.
The Mattermost version of the Mattermost resource, which names its image and tag in two fields.
The Gitea image tag. The chart gives the registry and the repository, so the helm-values manager cannot read it.
The DCGM exporter image tag, <DCGM version>-<exporter version>-<variant>. The exporter version is the version of the chart.
The one tag of the Argo Workflows controller and executor. It equals the argo pin of the tools lock.
The version of each Python tool of the tools lock. The pip-compile manager updates its <name>.in and <name>.txt.
The OpenSpec version of the tools lock. The npm manager updates openspec/package.json and its lockfile.
The Dev Containers CLI version of the tools lock. The npm manager updates devcontainers-cli/package.json and its lockfile.
The Style Dictionary version of the tools lock. The npm manager updates style-dictionary/package.json and its lockfile.

dependencyDashboard.footer: Held security fixes: `mcp` and `opentelemetry-api` in `src/devops_cli/tools_lock/semgrep.txt`. Semgrep pins their vulnerable versions, so uv finds no lock with the fixes. #3988 tracks them.

packageRules.description: OpenTofu reads its providers from the OpenTofu registry.
The tools of the tools lock come in one pull request for their non-major updates.

A file under src/devops_cli/ is runtime code, so the update is a fix: the Semantic PR title check refuses a hidden type there, and release-please releases it (#6061). Such files are the tools lock with its npm and pip-compile files and DEFAULT_PYTHON_VERSION. No custom manager writes another tool version into a Python file under src/ (#5585). A group takes the prefix of its first update, so each group with such a member sets the prefix itself: python runtime and bandit.
Lock file maintenance writes the npm lockfiles of the tools lock again, and the pip-compile refresh its requirements files, so it is a fix (#6061).
A custom manager of a file under k8s/ updates the cluster.
Renovate reads an Application source with no chart as a git dependency. Argo CD tracks main on purpose (ADR 0013), so those dependencies stay off.

Each Grafana plugin release names the Grafana it needs as grafanaDependency, which Renovate cannot read. A minor release can need a newer Grafana minor, so each plugin gets its own pull request, held to the major that the running Grafana major needs.
prBodyNotes: Before the merge, check that the Grafana image of the `grafana` chart meets the `grafanaDependency` of this release: https://grafana.com/api/plugins/{{{depName}}}/versions/{{{newVersion}}}. Grafana installs the pinned version at start.

packageRules.description: The Grafana drilldown app plugins stay on major 3.
The grafana-llm-app plugin stays on major 1.
SearXNG publishes many tags a day. A tag has no minimum release age (CONTRIBUTING.md, Dependency Versions). Each tag ends in a commit hash, which the versioning ignores.
prBodyNotes: Before the merge, read the notes of the release on the engines that the settings keep, and run `devops k8s searxng-check` against the new image on the cluster (`docs/CLUSTER.md`, section SearXNG).

packageRules.description: A base image update of the service image is a fix, so release-please releases it. Other updates stay chore and release nothing alone, except a chart update.

A chart update changes the chart that deploy-stack and Argo CD install: deploy-stack reads the version from the Application of the chart (#6060). So the update is a fix, and release-please releases it (#6054).
Coupled pins: a test compares these files, so one pull request updates them all. The trivy-action version inputs, the tools lock and the devcontainer image.
The tools lock, the devcontainer image and the Argo Workflows values tag.
The tools lock, the devcontainer image and the cloudflared image of the cluster.

The two Dockerfiles and the setup-uv version inputs. The uv image of the service image's Dockerfile is a fix by the base image rule, and a group takes the prefix of its first update, so the group sets the prefix itself.

.node-version, the node images and the devcontainer node feature. The node image of the service image's Dockerfile is a fix by the base image rule, and a group takes the prefix of its first update, so the group sets the prefix itself.
Every Python 3.<minor> place. A new minor gets its own branch, so its Dashboard approval does not stop the digest and patch updates.
prBodyNotes: A new Python minor is a migration: change the other `python3.<minor>` paths (`git grep -n 'python3\.'`) and the `python:3.<minor>-slim` defaults under `src/` in this pull request, then run the full gate.

packageRules.description: The ruff dev dependency and the ruff-pre-commit hook.
The bandit dev dependency, the tools lock and bandit.in and bandit.txt.
The actionlint image of the devcontainer image and of the ci.yml step.
The DCGM exporter chart and image: the exporter version of the image tag is the version of the chart. A group takes the prefix of its first update, so the group sets the fix prefix of a chart update.

The OpenSpec package, its lockfile and the tools lock. Each release comes on the day it is published, not on the schedule of the preset, so the project uses the newest skills and planning standard (#5078). The skills that OpenSpec generates change with its version, so the branch writes them again.
prBodyNotes: Before the merge, run `uv run --frozen devops install-tools --tool openspec` and `uv run --frozen devops openspec regenerate` on this branch and push the generated skills; Renovate runs no upgrade task until #6020. The regeneration needs Git and access to github.com, because OpenSpec installs its skills from the release tag of its repository.
Before the merge, record OpenSpec again for the tests that replay it (`tests/support/openspec_recording.py` says how), and run `uv run devops openspec check`.

packageRules.description: A feature update writes the devcontainer lockfile again with the pinned Dev Containers CLI.
prBodyNotes: Before the merge, run `uv run --frozen devops install-tools --tool devcontainers-cli` and `devcontainer upgrade --workspace-folder . --config .devcontainer/image/devcontainer.json` on this branch and push `.devcontainer/image/devcontainer-lock.json`; Renovate runs no upgrade task until #6020.

packageRules.description: The gh-dash schema fixture holds the schema of the pinned version.
prBodyNotes: Before the merge, replace `tests/fixtures/gh_dash_schema/` with the schema of the new version.

packageRules.description: The tuicr configuration test runs the pinned binary.
prBodyNotes: Before the merge, run `uv run devops ci test tests/config/test_tuicr_config.py` with the new binary.

packageRules.description: A LiteLLM release can change the gateway configuration and its migrations.
prBodyNotes: Before the merge, follow the upgrade plan of #4406: read the release notes and the migrations, and load `k8s/llm/gateway/config.yaml` with the new release.

packageRules.description: pydantic-ai 2.67 and later cap google-genai below 3, and the lock holds an older pydantic-ai, so lock maintenance would move google-genai to 3 alone. The pydantic-ai move of #5098 removes this hold.

semgrep pins mcp==1.29.0, also in its newest release (1.185.0 on 2026-11-16), so uv finds no lock of the semgrep tool with the security fix, and Renovate stopped the fix as an empty commit at each run. The hold ends when the lock takes the fix. #3988 tracks the advisories of the tools lock.

semgrep pins opentelemetry-api~=1.37.0, also in its newest release (1.185.0 on 2026-11-16), so uv finds no lock of the semgrep tool with the security fix, and Renovate stopped the fix as an empty commit at each run. The hold ends when the lock takes the fix. #3988 tracks the advisories of the tools lock.

A person runs devops k8s searxng-check against each new SearXNG image on the cluster, so a SearXNG update waits for an approval on the Dependency Dashboard. It gets its own branch, so that the other container images do not wait for it (#6029, #6051).
